children: Investar announced its CEO adopted a Rule 10b5-1 plan to exercise up to 16,952 options expiring March 2027 and sell a portion of the shares.
CEO John J. D’Angelo adopted a prearranged trading plan under Rule 10b5-1 effective Dec 3, 2026 to Mar 31, 2027.
Plan permits orderly exercise of up to 16,952 options that expire March 2027 and sale of acquired shares.
Action taken for personal long-term financial and tax planning; CEO still exceeds company share ownership guidelines.
Any transactions under the plan will be reported on Form 4; company may not disclose future officers’ 10b5-1 plans.
